thingdescriptiongroups.description: Containers for Thing Descriptions related by an application-defined grouping, such as a tenant, fleet, or physical site

thingdescriptions.description: A W3C WoT Thing Description served as a document. Each Version contains one complete WoT-TD 1.1 JSON-LD document. An optional resolution-plan profile does not create a third Resource kind or validate an unresolved plan as a result

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a Thing Description share one format

wotid.name: wotid
wotid.description: The document's authored WoT identifier: the 'id' member, verbatim. It identifies the document in the WoT identifier space and is distinct from the client-chosen thingdescriptionid within this registry. All Versions share one wotid; it MUST NOT encode a document revision

derivedfrom.name: derivedfrom
derivedfrom.description: Authored WoT identifiers of Thing Models this Thing Description extends or composes. These are document identifiers, not xids, and can be matched against the document's own references

license.name: license
license.description: The license the document is offered under, as an SPDX license expression or a URL. Advisory provenance metadata

publisher.name: publisher
publisher.description: The organization that published the document. Advisory provenance metadata

standardsbody.name: standardsbody
standardsbody.description: The standards organization that defines or endorses the document, where one does, for example 'W3C' or 'OPC Foundation'. Advisory provenance metadata

canonicalurl.name: canonicalurl
canonicalurl.description: The canonical upstream location of the document, where it is also published outside this registry. Advisory provenance metadata

maturity.name: maturity
maturity.description: Advisory provenance metadata indicating whether the document is Standard, Vendor, Community, or Experimental. It does not affect the document's semantic identity

documentdigest.name: documentdigest
documentdigest.description: Server-computed digest of the stored document file octets. Present only when the registry implements the WoT digest-publication profile; it does not make the Version immutable

value.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits encoding the full SHA-256 digest

documentbase.name: documentbase
documentbase.description: Optional original absolute document location. An authorized resolver profile may use it as a document-loader starting location; it does not override the authored TD base or JSON-LD processing

resolutionpolicy.name: resolutionpolicy
resolutionpolicy.description: Optional suggested policy attachment; it does not authorize or activate processing

digest.description: Full SHA-256 digest of the exact policy file octets

resolutionrecords.name: resolutionrecords
resolutionrecords.description: Optional immutable, digest-pinned resolution-record attachments. Separate records may describe different approved uses of one document

digest.description: Full SHA-256 digest of the exact record file octets

rootdigest.description: Full SHA-256 digest of the root document file octets bound by this record

purpose.description: Optional descriptive use label; not an authorization

thingmodelgroups.description: Containers for Thing Models related by an application-defined grouping, such as a vendor or product family

thingmodels.description: A W3C WoT Thing Model served as a document. Each Version contains one complete WoT-TM 1.1 JSON-LD document. An optional resolution-plan profile does not create a third Resource kind or validate an unresolved plan as a result

wotprocessinggroups.description: Container for discoverable WoT processing profile descriptors and reusable configurations. These documents are not executable code, authorization, or deployment instructions

processingprofiles.description: A WoT processing profile descriptor served as a JSON document. Its stable identity does not freeze the bytes of a mutable Core Version

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a processing profile share one format

stableprofileuri.name: stableprofileuri
stableprofileuri.description: Stable logical URI equal to the descriptor document's id. It identifies the profile across revisions, not a Core Version or byte-integrity guarantee

processingconfigurations.description: A reusable, root-free WoT processing configuration served as a JSON document. A consumer must select it explicitly; it does not select a root, target, operation, or deployment

format.name: format
format.description: The document format. All Versions of a processing configuration share one format

configurationuri.name: configurationuri
configurationuri.description: Stable logical URI equal to the configuration document's id. It identifies the configuration across revisions, not a Core Version or byte-integrity guarantee
